summary: Frontend-only verification of Razorpay payment integration features. All 6 requested checks PASSED. (1) Join page (/join) shows 'Registration Fee Required' banner with '₹499' and 'One-time fee' subtitle. (2) Submit button reads 'Register & Pay ₹499' (rendered from paymentSettings.registration_fee). (3) Admin Settings tab shows 'Payment Settings' section with 'Razorpay Integration - Configured' badge, 'Paid Registration' toggle (ON), and 'Registration Fee (₹)' numeric input pre-filled with 499 INR. (4) Clicking 'Save Payment Settings' triggers toast 'Payment settings updated!' (POST /api/payment-settings success). (5) 'Events & Payments' tab is visible in Admin sidebar (7th tab, with rupee icon, highlighted yellow). (6) Events tab renders 'Create New Event / Contest' form with Event Title, Entry Fee (₹) required field (default 500), Event Type dropdown (Contest), Max Participants, Deadline, Active toggle, Description. Existing event 'BFM Model Contest 2024' is listed with ₹1000 entry fee. GET /api/payment-settings returned {payment_enabled:true, registration_fee:499, razorpay_configured:true}.

issues: Tab bar now has 15 tabs wrapping to 2 rows. Consider grouping (Content / Payments / Media / Settings) or using a collapsible sidebar for better UX.

critical_code_review_comments: App.js JoinPage (lines 1400-1820) contains inline Razorpay script loading, order creation, and verification logic - would benefit from extraction into a usePayment hook or PaymentService module.

Payment fee is hardcoded fallback (499) in useState default in App.js:1404 - correctly overridden by API but ensure UI shows loading state until /api/payment-settings resolves to avoid flashing wrong amount.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing 'BFM Model Contest 2024' event.
